open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have merge {a b c d : List Expression.Ident} (h : a.Subset c) (h' : b.Subset d) :
      (a ++ b).Subset (c ++ d) :=
    fun _ hx => List.mem_append.mpr ((List.mem_append.mp hx).imp (@h _) (@h' _))
  intro h
  induction h <;>
    try solve
    | exact List.Subset.empty
    | assumption
    | apply merge <;> first | assumption | (apply merge <;> assumption)
  case app hn ihfn ihe =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · exact fun _ hx => hx
    · next hfalse =>
      cases hn IsOldPred.oldPred
      exfalso
      apply hfalse
      rfl
    · exact merge ihfn ihe
